answer: After the single authorised SRAM download the A1 UART is completely silent (0 bytes in 150 s, twice). Before the download the board still ran the b8 bit and emitted 7 x 97-byte v2 packets (A5 5A 61 02), so the UART/baud path is good; the silence starts exactly at the download. JTAG download and the COM8 listener cannot run together on this single-FTDI board: hwserver logged 'Error @ mpsse.cpp:90 : usb_open() failed' while COM8 was held open. Diagnostic gate NOT achieved: no v3 packet, so the raw-store question (A/B/C/D) is unanswered this round.
